// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// The near miss the establishment register invites. @/lib/establishmentRegister
// is on the allowlist because the health tile needs one job key out of it;
// @/lib/establishmentSearch is the file next to it, it is where a reader would
// expect the register's helpers to live, and it is not permitted.
//
// The reason is not stylistic. That module plans the teacher-facing search, so
// it names `postcode` — a denied identifier — and it exists to build queries an
// operator has no business running. Letting it in would put a browse surface for
// the register one import away from every operator screen, and it would put a
// denied column name into the ops scan, where the tempting fix is to stop
// denying it.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";
import { planSearch } from "@/lib/establishmentSearch";

export async function findSchools(query) {
  await requireOperator();
  const plan = planSearch(query);
  return db.establishment.findMany({ where: { name: { startsWith: plan.namePrefix } } });
}
